ship.source: Metadata-only Community Edition 2.670 shiplist inventory (issue #6, baseline issue #37). Codes and column names only. No ship rows and no stat values.

TEST-PH.note: Synthetic phaser used by duel fixtures. Same capacitor rule as a real phaser code.

TEST-PHOT.note: Synthetic photon. maxRange 30 is a fixture stand-in, not the 75-unit probe.

Phot.note: Normal arming accepts 2 per rules-turn until 4 is stored. The mount is not ready before armTurns (2) times RULES_TURN_SECONDS, which is 66 s. A full-allocation reading is about 64 s, inside that two-turn gate. Hold is 1 per rules-turn after that. A hit is 8 points at every range. Chance: 100% to 1k, 81% to 3k, 62.5% (5/8) to 5k, 40% (inside 31-50%) to 10k, 25% (inside 12.5-31%) to 15k, and 12.5% (1/8) out to 30k. A shared edge stays on the inner band. Nothing past 30k. The reading puts the cutoff somewhere in 26-30k. Overload numbers are still unverified.

Dis1.note: Klingon and Lyran Disruptor-1 [H]. 5 through 1.6k, 0-4 from 1.6k to 4.8k, 0-3 through 16k. Arms on one rules-turn, inside the 31-36 s reading.

Dis4.note: K-C8 Disruptor-4 [H]. 0-4 at 2.4-3.9k, 0-3 at 6-15k, 0-2 at 16.5-31k. Ranges under 2.4k were not sampled, so they share the 0-4 band. Arm time 32 s (960 ticks). The Lyran close-range 0-5 at 1.4k is a separate reading and is not merged into this table.

PlaD.note: Defensive plasma. The HUD read 0 throughout. No damage table.

PlaF.note: Launch yield 20. Arm time about 102 s. Provisional max launch range 17k from the flat HUD samples. This directDamage is the launch yield, not impact damage. In-flight falloff is unmeasured.

PlaG.note: Launch yield 20. Arm time about 102 s. Provisional max launch range 25.4k. directDamage is the launch yield, not impact damage.

PlaR.note: Launch yield 50. Arm time about 124 s. The cutoff is above 29.5k and was not crossed, so 29.5k is only the last observed launch range. directDamage is the launch yield, not impact damage.

PlaS.note: Launch yield 30. Arm time about 95 s, the middle of 90-100 s. Both tubes together were about 135 s. The cutoff is above 29.5k. directDamage is the launch yield, not impact damage.

DroA.note: Rack A [M]. 12 per drone, flat from 0.8k through at least 29.8k, the same yield as Rack F. The Mirak run did not cross the cutoff. 33.5k is the Klingon Rack F figure. Seven drones per rack. That count is not a clock.

DroB.note: Rack B [M]. Same 12-point drone as Rack A. Eleven drones per rack. That count is not a clock. Max range was not crossed on Mirak.

DroC.note: Rack C [M]. Same 12-point drone as Rack A. Seven drones per rack. That count is not a clock. Max range was not crossed on Mirak.

DroF.note: Missile Rack F [H]. 12 per drone from 1k to 33k. Initial arm about 44 s. Reload about 65-68 s is not a separate clock. Max range about 33.5k.

Fus.note: Hydran fusion [H]. Arms in about 32 s at 4 energy. Rolls fitted to the expected centers. 0 past about 11k through the 23.5-25k max.

HB.note: Hydran hellbore [H] through 21.4k. The max range past 21.4k is unmeasured, so there is no band beyond it. Arm time about 65.5 s, the middle of 63-68 s. Energy cost was not read.

PPD.note: ISC PPD [H]. 0 under about 4k. Then 6, 5, 4, and after the unsampled 18-25k gap, 3 at about 25.5k and 2 through 30.3k. Nothing past about 30.4k. The gap has no band, so a shot there does not pick a damage.

ADD6.note: AMD-6 on the Z-DN [M-H]. 0-6 per mount at 0.8-4.0k and expected 0 against ships, so it is drone-only. Hard cutoff 4.0k. The sim has no drone interception, so this entry does not deal that roll to a ship.

ADD12.note: Observed Arc values are only 1. Whether that number is reloads or rack capacity is TO VERIFY.

Ph1.note: Common Phaser-1 uses the Gorn G-DN curve [H]. A shared edge stays on the inner band. 0-2k is 3-6, 2-4k is 2-4, 4-6k is 2-3, 6-9k is 1-2, 9-15k is 0-1, 15-26k is 0-1 (the expected center there is 0.2-0.3). Damage is 0 from 26k through 26.4k. Nothing past 26.4k. ISC runs slightly longer, about 30k [M]; that longer tail is not a second table.

Ph2.note: K-D7 Phaser-2 [M]. One seeded combat-stream roll per shot, uniform on the inclusive integer band. The band is the narrow roll whose mean is the expected damage, and it sits inside the observed envelope. A shared edge stays on the inner band, so 1000 is still 3-5. Nothing past 16000. Re-arm is about 17-18.5 s in the reading; the charge still fills from the energy plan, so that clock is not a separate gate.

Ph3.note: Effective Phaser-3 range is about 4.2k from the ISC I-DN [M]. Inside 2k the roll is 1-2. 2-3k is 1-2. 3-4.2k is 0-1. Nothing past 4.2k. The earlier Lyran 16k figure counted a nonzero max and is not the cutoff.

PhG.note: Hydran Phaser-G [H]. Rolls fitted to the expected centers. Nothing past about 16k.

TEST-FA.note: Synthetic forward wedge equal to shield facing 0.

FX.reading: Forward arc extended through both side facings. Stern stays out.

FHL.reading: Left half of the extended forward arc, bow included.

FHR.reading: Right half of the extended forward arc, bow included.

FLLX.reading: Forward-left shoulder plus the rear-left facing. Bow stays out.

FRRX.reading: Forward-right shoulder plus the rear-right facing. Bow stays out.

RX.reading: Rear arc extended through both forward shoulders. Bow stays out.

LS.reading: The two left-side facings. This provisional set matches FLLX until playtest splits them.

RS.reading: The two right-side facings. This provisional set matches FRRX until playtest splits them.

LP.reading: Forward-left facing, read as a narrow port arc. Provisional set matches FLL.

RP.reading: Forward-right facing, read as a narrow starboard arc. Provisional set matches FRR.

LW.reading: Rear-left facing, read as a left wing.

RW.reading: Rear-right facing, read as a right wing.

LLR.reading: Rear-left and stern. Provisional set matches RAL.

RRR.reading: Rear-right and stern. Provisional set matches RAR.

fighter.source: ftrlist codes that are not already in the shiplist set. Ph2, Ph3 and PhG are the shiplist rows.

DroI.note: ftrlist letter arc ALL. Not a shiplist reload count.

DroVI.note: ftrlist letter arc ALL. Not a shiplist reload count.

costFallback.note: Same integers as TEST-PH and TEST-PHOT. Not measured Community Edition costs. The sim applies phaser when a phaser row omits chargeCost, and photon when a photon row omits armCost. A row that names its own cost keeps that row. Writing the measured number on the code replaces the fallback without a code change.

disruptor.note: Normal draws 2 per rules-turn and is ready after one rules-turn (33 s). Overload draws 4 and is ready after the same turn. Damage is fixed per band. A miss is 0 and does not roll damage. 66.7% is 667/1000. Bands are 0–1, 1.1–2, 2.1–3, 3.1–5, 5.1–16, and 16.1–31k (100 range units per tenth). A labeled start such as 1.1k stays on the later band, and the range below that start stays on the inner band. The normal cutoff is the measured DISRUPTOR_MAX_RANGE, 31000. Overload bands are 0–1, 1.1–2, 2.1–4.9, and 5–9k. Past 9000 an overload shot does nothing.

reloadCountNote: Confirmed pairing: numeric Arc values 1, 2 and 3 occur only on DroA, DroB, DroC, DroF, DroG, ADD6 and ADD12, and every shiplist row of those codes has a numeric Arc. The cell is a whole-number count. Those racks have no firing arc and launch or fire in any direction; drones are seeking weapons. ADD racks only ever show 1. Whether the number means reloads or rack capacity is TO VERIFY by playtest. A numeric Arc on any other weapon is unknownArc. A letter arc or an empty Arc cell on a reloadCounted weapon is unknownArc. ftrlist DroI and DroVI use the letter arc ALL and are not reloadCounted.
